title: Steward roundtable — weekly notes (Liam)
content:
Purpose: quick steward-level roundtable to triage emergent infra/runtime console issues, pick 2 focus items, and assign owners. This is a working scratchpad — rough bullets, todo checkboxes, notes-to-self.

Meeting logistics
- When: weekly Thursday 09:30 PT (block 30m).
- Attendees: eng-serving-runtime core stewards + console on-call (Aisha, Diego, Priya, Liam). Invite: quick sync calendar + #runtime-steward thread.
- Goal: surface high-risk regressions, confirm mitigations, clear action owners for the week.

Prep (things to pull before the call)
- P90 / P99 gen latency (last 24h) by model family (compare to baseline from Tue).
- Cache hit-rate and prefix-KV miss spike analysis (Grafana: cache.prefix_hit).
- Console error-rate for rollout pages (trace IDs from the last 48h).
- Any rollback/canary notes from product (linked in JIRA ticket INF-4219).

Agenda (30m)
1) Quick pulse (5m) — ops metrics snapshot (Liam)
   - p90 gen latency: current 210ms vs baseline 180ms. Notable bump between 02:00–05:00 UTC.
   - cache hit-rate: 88% (target 93%).
2) Incident-ish triage (10m) — prefix cache miss spike (Diego)
   - Symptoms: 3x token cost increase for some customers; KV miss correlated with small model family (quantized LLaMA variants).
   - Quick checks: kernel selection changes? recent runtime deploy?
   - Initial hypothesis: new kernel selector heuristics favored larger-gemm kernels causing eviction pressure on KV store.
3) Console regressions (7m) — rollout UI errors (Aisha)
   - Error class: 500 on /rollouts/{id}/history for users in eu-west region.
   - Likely cause: trace sampling misconfigured, downstream trace query timed out.
4) Action roundup + owner confirmations (8m)
   - Assign owners, set deadlines, note blockers.

Action items (working list)
- [ACTION] Diego: run KV-cache eviction simulation on staging (replay workload from 2026-03-06) and confirm if kernel selector change triggers higher eviction. Due: 2026-03-13. Linked: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/612.
- [ACTION] Liam: compile p90/p99 by model-family slice and add anomaly markers to dashboard; attach sample traces for 02:00–05:00 UTC window. Due: 2026-03-11. Linked: CONFLUENCE-RT-734.
- [ACTION] Aisha: escalate console 500s to tracing infra team, request increased trace query timeout for rollout history endpoint, and propose temporary caching in the console service. Due: 2026-03-12.
- [ACTION] Priya: validate canary policy for Llama-quant variants on Dedicated; propose fallback to previous kernel selector if deploy correlates with cost increase. Due: 2026-03-15. JIRA: INF-4219.
- [FOLLOW-UP] Liam -> schedule a 1:1 with Diego to walk through the eviction sim results; capture config diffs (kernel-selection flags) and add to the incident timeline. Target: 2026-03-13.

Notes-to-self / loose thoughts
- Low-hanging: adjust diag dashboards to highlight cache-hit degradations by customer tier (prod vs dedicated). Quick UX: red dot when hit-rate < 90% and cost-per-token > 1.5x baseline.
- Consider a small experiment: prefer stable kernel selector for quantized models for 24h to test cost delta. Might be lower risk than immediate rollback.
- Console workaround: server-side cache for rollout history (TTL 30s) to reduce trace queries — implement as feature flag behind canary.

Parking lot / non-urgent
- Revisit KV store sizing for dedicated pools next quarter (capacity planning doc).
- Longer term: add model-family aware eviction policy (preserve hot quantized KV keys).

Risks / blockers
- If eviction is caused by kernel selector heuristics, we need buy-in from runtime team to revert or adjust: may require a fast patch release.
- Console trace infra team may be bandwidth-constrained; fallback caching needs quick design review.

Meeting artifacts to attach after sync
- Staging eviction sim logs (Diego)
- Annotated latency dashboard snapshots (Liam)
- Console stack traces and trace IDs (Aisha)
- JIRA INF-4219 linkage + short incident timeline (Priya)

Quick checklist for the call (tick during meeting)
- [ ] Pulse metrics shown (p90/p99, cache hit-rate)
- [ ] Hypothesis for top item articulated
- [ ] Owners assigned with deadlines
- [ ] Any immediate mitigations decided? (rollback vs feature-flag)
- [ ] Follow-ups scheduled (1:1s / tech deep-dive)

End of scratchpad — copy finalized notes to shared drive / create follow-up Confluence incident page if we escalate.

Version history (notes)
- 2026-03-09: initial draft after late-night alerts.
- 2026-03-11: added action owners + dashboard notes.
- 2026-03-12: minor edits and finalized owners for this week's cycle.
